paginationVerifiedNote: Truncation mechanism identified and quantified (nodePagination.pageSize=6 hard cap per day/side, totalCount field available for detecting truncation). /list/recruit SSR pagination (?page=N) confirmed working, capped at page=140 (~2782 items, oldest reaches 2023-11-17).
statusSemanticsNote: status='OPEN' vs omitted/null measured on 2020-03: 887 vs 895 (OPEN drops ~0.9%). 'CLOSED' is not a valid ActivityStatus enum value (GraphQL validation error). status does NOT mean 'currently open for applications' — closed/expired postings ARE returned even with status='OPEN'. Recommend collector OMITS status filter.
transparentClientNote: curl_cffi(impersonate='chrome') + Referer header alone reproduces both APQ list calls and SSR detail pages with HTTP 200 — no Playwright/browser automation required for bulk collection. (robots.txt fetch alone triggered a curl_cffi 'challenge' verdict in the generic WAF validator, resolved via Playwright fallback, but this appears to be a validator false-positive on a tiny plain-text response, not a real block — the GraphQL/SSR endpoints used for actual collection returned clean 200s directly via curl_cffi with no such flag.)
rq1EligibleEstimatedShareNote: Pilot sample n=35 (2020-2026, 5/year): jobTypes populated 35/35 (100%). This is a PILOT signal only, not the formal PROMPT 0 D stratified sample (n>=100 required).
rq2EligibleEstimatedShareNote: Pilot sample n=35: bodyTextLength>=120 in 30/35 (85.7%). This measures only the length gate, not true section-parseability (required/preferred boundary detection) — true rq2EligibleFlag rate is likely LOWER once section-structure is checked. Needs formal PROMPT 0 D sample + PROMPT 2 pilot.
ncsEligibleEstimatedShareNote: Not estimated this pass — duty-sentence presence within ActivityText not yet systematically checked (only presence of the ActivityText entity itself was checked, not its section content).
externalAtsOnlyShareNote: Pilot sample n=35 (all recruit-type, 2020-2026): 35/35 (100%) had applyDetail pointing to a non-linkareer.com domain. This is the single most consequential finding of this recon pass — see P0_RECON_REPORT_FINAL.md §0 item 2.
